blueprints.label: A

blueprint.title: The Broken Bicycle Chain
blueprint.setting: A residential neighborhood in Beijing, late afternoon on a Saturday.
blueprint.problem: Xiao Ming's bicycle is broken, and he cannot get home while the weather is turning bad.
blueprint.incitingEvent: Xiao Ming falls off his bike because the chain falls off, and he does not know how to fix it.

beats.where: The street outside Xiao Ming's apartment building
beats.what: Xiao Ming is riding his bike home from the park when the chain falls off. He tries to put it back on but fails. He feels worried because he is tired.
Li Ming and Xiao Hong walk by. They see Xiao Ming struggling. Li Ming introduces himself as the new neighbor. Xiao Hong notices that Xiao Ming looks upset.
beats.because: Li Ming and Xiao Hong are walking past the scene of the accident.

beats.what: Li Ming asks what is wrong. Xiao Ming explains that his bike chain is broken. Li Ming says he knows how cars work, but not bikes. He asks if Xiao Ming needs help.
beats.because: They saw Xiao Ming was in trouble.

beats.what: Xiao Ming says he really needs help because it is getting dark. Li Ming says they can look together. Xiao Hong suggests checking the owner's manual. The relationship between Xiao Ming and Xiao Hong becomes better because of this talk.
beats.because: Xiao Ming accepted the offer of aid.

beats.what: Li Ming and Xiao Hong help Xiao Ming put the chain back on. It is difficult, but they work together. Xiao Hong holds the wheel, Li Ming fixes the metal links. Xiao Ming waits patiently.

beats.where: The street corner/Xiao Ming's home driveway
beats.what: The bike is fixed. Xiao Ming tests it; it works. He thanks them. Li Ming says if he comes back, he can borrow tools. Xiao Ming rides home happily. The three become friends.
beats.arrivedHow: Xiao Ming rides a short distance to his house.

blueprint.resolution: The bicycle is fixed, Xiao Ming returns home safely, and the neighbors establish a friendly relationship through mutual assistance.

targetPlan.why: To describe Xiao Ming as a male figure distinct from the others, or generally describing him as a young man.
targetPlan.speaker: narrator
targetPlan.intent: To identify the protagonist's gender/role in the scene.

targetPlan.why: To describe Xiao Hong as a female neighbor.
targetPlan.speaker: narrator

targetPlan.why: Li Ming asks if Xiao Ming requires assistance.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.refersTo: The act of fixing the bike
targetPlan.intent: To offer aid in a polite question.

targetPlan.why: Li Ming explicitly offers his aid.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.intent: To confirm he is willing to help.

targetPlan.why: Reflecting on how the interaction is improving their connection.
targetPlan.speaker: narrator
targetPlan.refersTo: The social bond between Xiao Ming and Xiao Hong
targetPlan.intent: To show the development of friendship.

targetPlan.why: Li Ming sets a condition for future interaction.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.intent: To propose a future conditional offer.

blueprints.label: B

blueprint.title: The Neighbors' Heavy Box
blueprint.setting: A residential apartment building hallway, afternoon
blueprint.problem: A heavy box blocks the hallway and belongs to a neighbor who cannot move it alone.
blueprint.incitingEvent: Li Ming sees an elderly woman struggling with a large box in the hallway.

beats.what: Li Ming is walking home and sees an old woman dropping her bag next to a big box. She looks tired and frustrated.
beats.arrivedHow: Li Ming walks from the street to the building entrance.

beats.what: The woman tries to lift the box but cannot. Li Ming realizes she needs help and decides to act. He calls his friends Xiaohong and Xiaoming.
beats.because: the woman is struggling and alone

beats.what: Xiaohong and Xiaoming arrive. Li Ming explains the situation. They discuss that even two people might not be enough, so they need three.
beats.arrivedHow: They walk from their own apartments in the building.

beats.what: The three boys lift the heavy box together. It is difficult, but they move it to corner. The woman watches them, smiling.
beats.because: they gathered three people to move the heavy object

beats.what: The woman thanks them. Li Ming asks at whom the box belongs. The woman says it is for her son, a man who works far away. She explains their relationship.
beats.because: the task is finished and they are talking

blueprint.resolution: The box is safely moved, the neighbor is grateful, and the boys learn about the connection between the neighbors.

targetPlan.why: Li Ming identifies the person in trouble. He needs to label 'this woman' to tell his friends.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.refersTo: The elderly neighbor struggling with the box
targetPlan.intent: To identify the person needing assistance

targetPlan.why: Li Ming explains to his friends on the phone that the situation requires help.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.refersTo: The act of helping the woman
targetPlan.intent: To state the necessity of intervention

targetPlan.why: Xiaoming adds to Li Ming's point: the box is heavy, AND it is tall, so it is hard to balance.
targetPlan.speaker: 小明
targetPlan.refersTo: The physical properties of the box
targetPlan.intent: To add a reason why they need three people, not two

targetPlan.why: The woman verbally thanks them for their assistance after the physical act is done.
targetPlan.speaker: 妈妈 (The neighbor)
targetPlan.refersTo: The act of moving the box
targetPlan.intent: To express gratitude for the aid received

targetPlan.why: The woman describes the owner of the box. It is not her husband (who might be absent or deceased), but her son, an adult male.
targetPlan.speaker: 妈妈 (The neighbor)
targetPlan.intent: To identify the gender of the box's owner

targetPlan.why: The boys are curious. Li Ming asks the woman about the relationship between her and the man who sent the box.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.refersTo: The connection between the woman and the man
targetPlan.intent: To clarify family or social ties
